props.name: as
props.description: The element or component this component should render as. Can be overwritten by `asChild`.

props.name: asChild
props.description:
Change the default rendered element for the one passed as a child, merging their props and behavior.

Use this when you need a component to render through a child element while
keeping the primitive's props and behavior.

props.name: disabled
props.description: When `true`, prevents the user from interacting with the input.

props.name: displayValue
props.description: The display value of the input for the selected item. Does not work with `multiple`.

props.name: modelValue
props.description: The text input value. Can be bound with `v-model`.

props.name: placeholder
props.description: Placeholder text shown when the input is empty.
